text:
maria_gonzalez: Heads up — we have a candidate, Vivian Zhao, coming for an in-office loop next Thu 10:00–14:00 PT. She asked for two things: an ASL interpreter and a loaner Linux laptop with GPU for a short model eval. Can we confirm both before I send the final invite?

natalie_h: Thanks for flagging. Hiring manager here — the loop includes 3 interviews + a wrap. ASL is required, please book. Also ideally the laptop has Python + docker.

henry_cho: I can reserve Conf Rm A (floor 5) and add the hybrid Zoom link. Do we need USB C charger/power brick too?

it_ops: We have a loaner TuxBook (Ubuntu 22.04) with an RTX 3060 available. I can image it with `python3`, `docker`, and `nvidia-container-toolkit`. Need to know if we should pre-download the 1.2GB evaluation model.

maria_gonzalez: Yes please pre-download the model if possible — candidate will run a tiny prompt perf check. Also add an ethernet drop and a wired mouse.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Vivian Zhao — travel location: Barcelona, prefers reimbursement in EUR. Requested letter for visa support. Contact email: vivian.z@example.com

henry_cho: OK locking Conf Rm A 09:45-14:30 for setup and teardown. Zoom link: https://zoom.company.com/j/999999999. Will attach a door code for the security desk.

it_ops: Confirming laptop hold. To image the machine I need the exact model URL for the test artifacts and the SSH public key to preload. If you want HSM access we need a request form filled: <link to IT form>.

maria_gonzalez: I'll collect the SSH key from the candidate after I confirm. Also note: dietary restriction — halal only, + severe peanut allergy. Catering: single boxed lunch + labeled allergy card.

natalie_h: Reimbursement: send expense policy link + tell her EUR is fine. Also we'll provide a courtesy hotel if flight arrives before 9pm.

henry_cho: Security desk instructions for visitor badge: print badge with name, team = "Interviews", photo ID required. Door code to give on arrival: `#5271` (will send to security).

maria_gonzalez: Can someone generate a short agenda blob for the calendar invite? I'll include interpreter contact and parking details.

henry_cho: Agenda (short):
```
09:45 — Setup / laptop check
10:00 — Intro / Hiring mgr (Natalie)
10:30 — System design (Eng)
11:15 — Lunch + buffer
11:45 — Live coding (take-home on machine)
12:45 — Wrap / PM + comp discussion
13:15 — Recruiter + next steps
```

it_ops: Also adding a small note: bring your webcam lighting + we'llprovide a noise-cancelling headset if needed.

maria_gonzalez: Perfect. I'll: 1) confirm ASL interpreter booking 2) request image + SSH key from candidate 3) send visa support letter draft 4) add catering order (halal, peanut-free) 5) send calendar invite with agenda + Zoom.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to Vivian.z@example.com, Natalie, Henry, Maria. Invite ID: 1851234567-ivncv.

natalie_h: :thumbsup: thanks team. One last ask — can we include a quick note in the invite about public transit options and parking validation?

maria_gonzalez: Yup adding transit and parking validation (2 hours) to the invite now.

henry_cho: If anything else pops up ping me. I'll drop a sticky note on the door 15m prior.

maria_gonzalez: Closing loop — will follow up once interpreter confirmed and laptop imaged. Thanks all. :pray:
